findings.issue: בִּמְקוֹם is the preposition ב plus the noun מָקוֹם (place) in construct with definite הָעֹלָה, so the act is at the place of the burnt offering. «en lugar de» is the substitution idiom instead of, and drops that place.

notes: The qal 3ms sequence, singular hand, head construct, repeated חַטָּאת, and עֹלָה otherwise match.
